0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>A new rumor has the dwarves of Komra in a right tizzy.

24.original: Speak with the dig site watch.

25.original: Speak with the dig site chief.

28.original: Deliver the automaton core to Anogg.

30.original: Deliver the mining lantern to the dig site chief.

48.original: You heard the latest rumor out of Komra? The strangest find in recent memory, though actual details as to what said find actually is have yet to emerge.

49.original: If you do happen to come into any juicy tidbits, I'd be keen to hear 'em. The suspense is killing me here...

50.original: Remember: I'm the one what put you on the scent! So if you learn any exciting secrets, you'd best share them with me! 'Tis only fair!

51.original: I can neither confirm nor deny the existence of a new discovery of untold value that only a select few are allowed to see for themselves.

52.original: That said...there may come a time when I find myself utterly fascinated by that pile of rocks over there and would be completely oblivious to anyone attempting to sneak past...

54.original: ...You're a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of the world, ain't you? Don't make me say it plain.

55.original: Wicked white! How bloody stupid are you!?

56.original: You─the imbecile─give me─the guard─ten thousand gil. Then you─the imbecile─get to walk past me─the guard─and see the amazing find. Got it?

60.original: Then you do not get to pass. You go away! Good day, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>!

61.original: Heh heh, about time you started playing by the rules...

62.original: Lali-what in the blazing hells do you think you're doing man-ho!? Is that any way for a guard to behave? Is it!?

66.original: It's...<sniffle>...it's not fair, I tell you... A dwarf toils day in and day out for a pittance, only to try and make a little something extra on the side, and what does it get him... <sob>

67.original: Right, well, anyway─bugger off. None may pass without the Chief's permission, which I know you haven't got.

68.original: Oh look, it's the sinner who cost me my dinner. Go hassle the chief if you want to go in, 'cause I sure as hells ain't letting you pass.

69.original: No time for you, friend. We've our hands full with this latest find of ours...

70.original: Wait, wait, don't tell me. I assume you came all this way to put in for the position? Sorry, but it's already been filled.

72.original: Came all this way for the what-now?

73.original: You know what they say about assumptions...

74.original: Eh? Don't go playing silly buggers with me. The queer ruins we found deep in a cavern through a tunnel over there! The one filled with all kinds of machina? To the point we've started calling it a bloody machina graveyard?

75.original: Yes, well, we were looking to hire on another guard, but the position's since been filled by that fellow what tried to swindle you a moment ago.

76.original: So you're out of luck, I'm afraid. But chin up, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Your time'll come round again soon enough.

77.original: Since you're here and still unemployed, mind delivering a message for me? It's for two younglings in Komra, Anogg and Konogg─sister and brother, twins. Fond of wearing white and black. Twin thing, I suppose.

78.original: The message is as follows: “Lali-bleeding-ho! This is no place for children to be messing about! Stay far, far, far away, or else!” Got it?

79.original: If I told you several times before you're not getting in, what makes you think I've since changed my mind? I mean, think about it...

80.original: Anogg and Konogg, wearing white and black. You'll know 'em when you see 'em. And don't forget the lali-bleeding-ho!

81.original: Hm? You got business with us?

82.original: ...The chief put you up to this? And you <hex:021A020203>agreed<hex:021A020103>? Haven't you got anything better to do with your time?

83.original: Wait...those garments...that quiet confidence...those powerful neck muscles sculpted by a lifetime of nodding...

84.original: (This is that sinner everyone's been talking about, Sister! <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503>'s the guileless fool we've been waiting for! The perfect patsy!)

85.original: (Good thinking, Brother. Let's get right to it, then!)

86.original: Ah... Ahem! You wouldn't happen to be that kindly stranger everyone likes and adores? You are, aren't you!? Perhaps you would be willing to do us a teensy little favor? Of course you would!

87.original: My brother and I are conducting some highly secret research at the moment, but we've hit a dead end. To continue, we need to get our hands on an automaton core...

91.original: Oh, don't be silly! Everyone knows you're the soul of generosity! A sinner who cannot help but render aid to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> fellow sinner in their hour of need! Not for fame or fortune or any other reward, but simply for the joy of it! Am I wrong?

93.original: ...This is another one of those moments where it really doesn't matter what I have to say, isn't it?

97.original: But despite your vehement refusal, deep down we both know you cannot help but aid us in our endeavor. 'Tis your nature. We will pretend that you agreed without a fuss and that will be the end of it.

99.original: The core we require is being stored with other sundry materials on the cliffs above us. Once you have it, bring it to my sister.

100.original: As soon as you have that automaton core, bring it to me straightaway.

101.original: Don't dally, sinner! We need that core for our research!

102.original: Can't you see we're in the middle of a very important conversation?

103.original: You gave 'em the ol' lali-bleeding-ho, did you? Hope they took it to heart.

105.original: And is that the core I spy in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> hot little hands?

106.original: Heh heh heh, brilliant! All we've got to do is sell this for a small fortune, and then we'll be one step closer to seeing our plans for world domination to fruition...

108.original: (Oh, right! That was a close one, Brother!)

109.original: Now then, for our next request...

110.original: Lali-what in the hells are you two up to-ho!? If you're even thinking of taking advantage of this good sinner, I'll tan both your hides and toss you from the top of White Oil Falls! Now get you gone!

112.original: Sorry about that. They don't know any better, on account of them being all on their own. No parents.

113.original: They've lost more than most, you could say. More than anyone ever should.

114.original: Anyway, I've been meaning to ask. Everyone says you're the soul of generosity─a sinner who cannot help but render aid to <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> fellow sinner in their hour of need. Not for fame or fortune or any other reward, but simply for the joy of it. Am I wrong?

117.original: I'd swear you just repeated nearly word for word what those two...never mind.

118.original: We're short a lantern at the dig site. Should be another in the cave just outside of the village. Mind going and fetching it for me? 'Course you don't.

119.original: Once you've got it, bring it to me back at the dig. Oh, and don't worry─I'll see you compensated for the trouble.

120.original: Got that lantern for me? No? It should be in the cave just outside of town.

121.original: There you are. I presume that lantern you're holding's for yours truly?

122.original: Much obliged. Here─a little something for your trouble.

123.original: Never let it be said a dwarf of character doesn't pay his debts. Anyway, if we've nothing else to discuss...

125.original: We want to see the ruins! Please please please please please!?

126.original: No, no, no, no, no. It's dangerous and off-limits and even if I were the sort of man who could be bribed─which I'm not─I'd be shocked if you two had anything valuable enough for me to risk my neck looking the other way.

127.original: Why are you and everyone else so bloody obsessed with trying to get a look at the cavern filled with mysterious machina anyway? It's just a bloody scrap heap, isn't it?

128.original: No no─it's so much more! Based on our research, we have reason to believe that those ruins contain─

129.original: (Hush, Sister! How many times must you nearly give the game away!? It's supposed to be our secret!)

130.original: (Oh, yes, right. Right. It's just so hard sometimes to contain my enthusiasm...)

131.original: Nothing. These ruins contain nothing of value whatsoever. We shall leave you to your affairs, honorable guard sir, and bid thee farewell.

132.original: Honestly, I'm beginning to hope that there really is nothing of value in there, for all the trouble it's causing. But as I was about to say─if we've got nothing else to discuss, then you'd best be on your way. It's dangerous to wander about an active dig, and I don't want anyone getting hurt.

133.original: What does it matter to you if we go through? It's not like it's your find! You have nothing to lose!

134.original: You really must let us through. It's a matter of the utmost importance!

135.original: ...What in the hells are you two on about?

136.original: Poked around Komra, did you? Learn anything about that big find?

137.original: A machine graveyard, eh? Interesting, interesting... This could be the beginning of a great and grand adventure. Or an utterly nonsensical one─though that does have its appeal on occasion, I'll allow.

138.original: Folks ought to keep busy, that's my motto. Idle hands are the fae's playthings.

139.original: Wicked white, if you start pestering me like those twins to get inside... <sigh> I tell you, what's the point of being a guard if you can't profit off it? Why would anyone ever take this job?
